2 Items From Sweden:
25% Increase In Violent Crimes In Holland; French Cannabis Report Blamed  On "Drug Liberal."

Press release July 1, 1998

25 percent increase in violent crimes in the Netherlands

According to a report in the SEC magazine from the Dutch Ministry of Justice, there has been a 25 percent increase in violent crimes in the Netherlands between 1991 and 1996.

In 1991 there was an average of 39 violent crimes per 10.000. In 1996, the number was 49 per 10.000.

Press release July 1, 1998

French report says drinking worse than cannabis

A French report commissioned by the French drug liberal Junior Health Minister Bernard Kouchner concludes that drinking is a far worse health hazard than smoking cannabis.

The report, carried out by the state medical research institute INSERM, and published by the 'Le Monde' newspaper, questions French laws that place few restricitons on drinking but ban cannabis.

An activist who mailed a marijuana cigarette to every French MP was fined 50.000 ($8.400) last month.
